text: Small one: What is the seat count for Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines? I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats on Pemberline Dock. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also told her that Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats starting 2027-01-01, so 185 is still the current number for the QBR deck.

Both numbers come from North team contract pages, and Dana is on that team. Seat counts aren't finance figures, so no approval was needed. I left out prices and discounts.
